name: WhatsApp Business
description: WhatsApp Business Platform is Meta's hosted API for businesses to receive customer messages and send service, utility, authentication, and marketing messages through registered WhatsApp business phone numbers.
agentUseSummary: WhatsApp Business cannot yet be connected through Relay. Meta's Cloud API and Embedded Signup require a Relay-owned Meta app, approved permissions, a compliant technology-provider setup, customer WhatsApp Business Account and phone-number onboarding, signed webhooks, and representative acceptance. No messaging authority is exposed while that provider review and production configuration remain incomplete.

capabilities.label: Receive business messaging events
capabilities.description: After provider acceptance, receive bounded inbound customer messages and message-status events for the connected WhatsApp Business Account through verified webhooks.

capabilities.label: Send business messages
capabilities.description: After provider acceptance, reply inside the customer-service window or initiate policy-compliant conversations with approved templates through the connected phone number.

capabilities.label: Manage message templates
capabilities.description: After provider acceptance, create and manage the connected business's message templates subject to Meta review and policy.

blocked.label: Connect before Meta review
blocked.description: Relay has not completed its Meta technology-provider setup, app review, production permission approval, Embedded Signup configuration, or representative account acceptance.

blocked.label: Receive WhatsApp events
blocked.description: Inbound message and delivery-status webhooks remain disabled until callback verification, signature validation, WABA subscription, account binding, replay handling, and redaction are accepted.

blocked.label: Send WhatsApp messages
blocked.description: Replies, template messages, media, reactions, location, contacts, interactive messages, and every other send remain unavailable before provider acceptance.

blocked.label: Manage WhatsApp business assets
blocked.description: Templates, phone numbers, profiles, subscriptions, quality settings, and WhatsApp Business Account administration remain unavailable before provider acceptance.

blocked.label: Use raw APIs or personal WhatsApp
blocked.description: Arbitrary Graph calls, raw webhook payloads, personal-chat access, browser or device automation, QR-session capture, unofficial libraries, and customer-supplied Meta secrets are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Provider review pending
approvalProfiles.description: No WhatsApp Business action is enabled until Meta approves Relay's production app and the complete customer onboarding, webhook, policy, and revocation contract passes representative acceptance.

runtimeSupport.description: A future Railway broker can mount bounded WhatsApp Business tools after Meta review; no OpenClaw tool is callable while provider review is pending.
A future Railway broker can mount bounded WhatsApp Business tools after Meta review; no Hermes tool is callable while provider review is pending.

providerSetup.blocker: Meta's official Cloud API requires a Meta business portfolio, WhatsApp Business Account, business phone number, access token, whatsapp_business_management and whatsapp_business_messaging permissions, and an explicitly subscribed webhook receiver. A multi-customer Relay product also needs a Relay-owned Meta app, Embedded Signup and customer asset binding, applicable technology-provider terms, production permission review, secret and callback configuration, and policy enforcement. None of that provider-console or representative-consent work is available to this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: The exclusive provider-console and production-acceptance task should establish Relay's Meta business and developer ownership, accept the applicable technology-provider terms, create and configure the production app and Embedded Signup flow, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/whatsapp-business/callback and the Railway webhook, request the minimum production permissions, complete Meta review, and run representative customer onboarding. It must verify WABA and phone-number binding, token lifecycle, webhook challenge and signature, event idempotency, message-window and template enforcement, opt-in and opt-out, media redaction, quality and rate errors, disconnect, revocation, and post-disconnect denial before Connect is enabled.

evidence.supports: Meta's official WhatsApp Business Platform collection identifies Cloud API as the hosted business-messaging API, requires a business portfolio, WhatsApp Business Account and phone number, documents user or system-user access tokens, and names whatsapp_business_management and whatsapp_business_messaging as its two core permissions.
Meta's official webhook collection requires an explicit WABA subscription, a webhook server, WABA identifier, and a system-user token with whatsapp_business_management.

Meta's technology-provider terms govern customer onboarding and require customer authorization, purpose-limited customer-data processing, protection of customer data, and compliance with the WhatsApp Business Solution terms.

WhatsApp's Business Messaging Policy requires recipient opt-in, opt-out handling, approved templates for business-initiated conversations, a 24-hour customer-service reply window, human escalation for automation, privacy controls, and compliance with restricted-use rules.
